rounds.text: Vikas Ecotech Ltd is significantly under-appreciated because the market prices the entire enterprise at half of its underlying net asset value, with a price-to-book ratio of just 0.50x based on a share price of ₹ 1.11 against a book value of ₹ 2.23 [E2]. This deep discount exists despite clear operational green shoots, specifically demonstrated by a year-on-year sales increase of 13% alongside sequential revenue growth quarter-on-quarter [E54, E56]. Furthermore, with a modest market capitalisation of ₹ 196 Cr [E3], the current valuation places the stock near the absolute bottom of its annual cycle, sitting merely 12% of the way up its 52-week range [E5]. Conceded: trailing profitability metrics remain weak, evidenced by a 3-year compounded profit growth decline of 31% [E10], a trailing twelve-month profit contraction of 61% [E11], and low returns on capital and equity of 2.3% and 0.8% respectively [E6, E7].
